repo_notes.content: Ashlr Stack is a Bun/TypeScript monorepo for configuring third-party services. Follow the source for actual behavior and distinguish source capabilities from published versions and provider readiness.

The core package implements providers and orchestration; the CLI and MCP server expose them. Credentials pass through provider flows and Phantom Secrets; describe the actual trust boundaries and avoid implying all output is redacted.

pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Explain the monorepo, package relationships, and the flow from CLI and MCP requests through core to providers.

pages.title: CLI Commands and Workflows
pages.purpose: Describe command registration in packages/cli/src/index.ts and the init, scan, recommend, apply, add and doctor workflows in packages/cli/src/commands.

pages.title: Providers and Provisioning
pages.purpose: Explain the provider registry, adapters, authentication and provisioning pipeline in packages/core/src/providers and packages/core/src/pipeline.ts.

pages.title: Configuration and Secrets
pages.purpose: Describe Stack configuration, local instance data, Phantom Secrets integration and credential handling in packages/core/src/config.ts and phantom.ts.

pages.title: MCP Server and Local Lane
pages.purpose: Explain tool definitions, CLI dispatch and the loopback local lane bridge in packages/mcp/src.

pages.title: Templates and Detection
pages.purpose: Describe project detection, templates and their use in initialization and recommendations in packages/core/src and templates/.

pages.title: Site and Generated Documentation
pages.purpose: Explain the Astro site in packages/site, generated reference material and documentation freshness scripts in scripts/freshness.

pages.title: Development and Testing
pages.purpose: Describe local setup, package tests, typechecking and linting using STACK.md and the repository scripts.
